summary: Marks and Spencer Group plc operates various retail stores. It operates through Fashion, Home & Beauty; Food; International; and Ocado segments. The company offers womenswear, menswear, lingerie, kids wear, beauty, and home products through UK and ROI, retail stores, and online. It also provides meat, fish, protein deli and dairy; produce and floral; meals, frozen, and food on the move; core basket; beers, wines, and spirits; and impulse and events, and hospitality services. In addition, it operates international franchises; and provides banking services. The company also exports its products. The company was founded in 1884 and is based in London, the United Kingdom.
